title: Review an output and see the release gate block it
summary: Inspect a blind review queue, record an honest abstention, and understand why a passing demo is not release evidence.
prerequisites: Complete the repository installation: Node.js 22+, npm ci, then npm run build.
Use Bash or another POSIX shell on macOS/Linux; use WSL on Windows. Run commands from the cloned repository root.
The checked-in verify.mjs helper only reads the tutorial outputs and checks the expected facts. All agent actions still use the visible Instrilo commands.
outcome: A bound human-review record and a saved blocked release decision, with strict defaults preserved.

verification.scope: Offline demo evaluation, blind queue creation, abstention recording, assessments, calibration, and the expected release exit code run through the CLI.
limitations: This guide records a tutorial abstention, not a claim that a person verified model quality.
No requirement coverage or production holdout evidence is fabricated.
Release is an evidence decision; it does not publish code or deploy resources.

steps.title: Create a deliberately insufficient evidence set
steps.body: One synthetic holdout case makes the boundary clear: it is reserved as holdout but remains synthetic. Demo execution produces no LLM judge score. prepare installs the generated npm dependencies before running the smoke evaluation.
steps.code:
set -eu
INSTRILO_PROJECT=.studio/tutorials/human-review-release
node dist/cli.js init human-review-release --directory .studio/tutorials
node dist/cli.js cases import "$INSTRILO_PROJECT" --file examples/quickstarts/delivery/demo-case.jsonl --replace
node dist/cli.js build "$INSTRILO_PROJECT"
node dist/cli.js prepare "$INSTRILO_PROJECT"
node dist/cli.js eval "$INSTRILO_PROJECT" --split holdout --output "$INSTRILO_PROJECT/reports/demo.json"
node dist/cli.js policy show "$INSTRILO_PROJECT" > "$INSTRILO_PROJECT/policy-before.json"
steps.expected: The smoke evaluation succeeds in demo mode. The saved policy still rejects demo and synthetic evidence.

steps.title: Inspect the exact output without prior verdicts
steps.body: The report ID comes from the saved report. The default queue hides automated and previous human verdicts; inspect its output before making any real review decision.
steps.code:
INSTRILO_REPORT_ID=$(node -p 'require("./"+process.argv[1]+"/reports/demo.json").id' "$INSTRILO_PROJECT")
node dist/cli.js review queue "$INSTRILO_PROJECT" --report "$INSTRILO_REPORT_ID" --output "$INSTRILO_PROJECT/blind-review.json"
cat "$INSTRILO_PROJECT/blind-review.json"
steps.expected: The queue contains the exact review-demo input/output and binding hashes for this report.

steps.title: Record an abstention and inspect calibration
steps.body: The supplied label explicitly says this is a synthetic demo and cannot establish answer quality. Replace it with your own verdict and reason only for actual reviewed evidence. The checked-in review-label helper fills in the actual saved report ID and writes that abstention; the CLI then records it.
steps.code:
node examples/quickstarts/delivery/review-label.mjs "$INSTRILO_PROJECT"
node dist/cli.js review label "$INSTRILO_PROJECT" --file "$INSTRILO_PROJECT/abstention.json"
node dist/cli.js review assessments "$INSTRILO_PROJECT" --report "$INSTRILO_REPORT_ID"
node dist/cli.js review calibrate "$INSTRILO_PROJECT" --report "$INSTRILO_REPORT_ID"
steps.expected: Assessments retain the abstention. Calibration cannot claim judge-human agreement from this unscored, abstained demo.

steps.title: Verify the strict gate blocks release
steps.body: Exit 2 is the correct result. Read the reasons; do not toggle allowDemo or allowSynthetic just to obtain a green status.
steps.code:
INSTRILO_RELEASE_EXIT=0
node dist/cli.js release "$INSTRILO_PROJECT" --report "$INSTRILO_REPORT_ID" --output "$INSTRILO_PROJECT/release-decision.json" || INSTRILO_RELEASE_EXIT=$?
test "$INSTRILO_RELEASE_EXIT" -eq 2
node dist/cli.js policy show "$INSTRILO_PROJECT" > "$INSTRILO_PROJECT/policy-after.json"
node examples/quickstarts/delivery/verify.mjs blocked-release "$INSTRILO_PROJECT"
steps.expected: The saved decision says allowed:false and identifies demo/synthetic evidence and missing requirement coverage. Policy is byte-for-byte unchanged.

troubleshooting: Use a fresh tutorial project name if init says the directory already exists. The commands create files and reports that deliberately refuse overwriting existing results.
Read the printed error and instrilo help --all before retrying. A failed assertion means the observed result differs from this guide.
Exit 2 from release means the gate ran and blocked the proposal. Exit 1 means a command, validation, or execution error and is not the expected result.
cleanup: The tutorial creates only its named project under .studio/tutorials. Keep reports if useful; remove that project directory when you no longer need it.
